summary: Diff adds a web manifest, a custom service worker script, an offline UI banner/hook, and a TWA build guide. However, the diff summary does not show the required generated Android icon PNG assets being added, does not show service worker registration in the app entrypoint, and the TWA guide (as shown) does not include explicit debug APK build steps. Several unrelated frontend/UI and feature changes also appear in the summaries but were not requested.

missing_requirements.requirement: Register a service worker so offline-capable behavior is active in the running app.
missing_requirements.reason: A service worker file (frontend/public/sw.js) is added, but the diff summary does not show any code that registers it (e.g., in main.tsx/index.tsx). Without registration, the service worker will not control pages and offline behavior may not take effect.

missing_requirements.requirement: Documentation includes steps to build a debug APK locally and notes what is out of scope.
missing_requirements.reason: The added TWA guide shows release/unsigned APK output from `bubblewrap build`, but the visible portion does not include explicit debug APK build steps (e.g., debug build commands) nor clearly states out-of-scope items such as Play Store publishing/signing.

missing_requirements.requirement: Add two new generated icon assets under frontend/public/assets/generated: android-app-icon.dim_192x192.png and android-app-icon.dim_512x512.png.
missing_requirements.reason: The manifest references these icon paths and the service worker precache list includes them, but the diff summary does not list these PNG files as added under frontend/public/assets/generated.

hallucinated_features.description: Added a footer with a caffeine.ai attribution link and UTM tracking.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested by the BuildRequest (which focuses on PWA/TWA packaging and Android icons).
